def center_crop_90(img):
    w, h = img.size
    new_w, new_h = int(w * 0.9), int(h * 0.9)
    left = (w - new_w) // 2
    top = (h - new_h) // 2
    return img.crop((left, top, left + new_w, top + new_h))

def predict_action_manual(model, input_ids, pixel_values, unnorm_key):
    with torch.inference_mode():
        inputs_embeds = model.get_input_embeddings()(input_ids)
        if pixel_values is not None:
            projected = model.projector(model.vision_backbone(pixel_values))
            mask = input_ids == model.config.image_token_index
            inputs_embeds[mask] = projected.reshape(-1, projected.shape[-1])
        outputs = inputs_embeds
        past = None
        generated_ids = []
        for _ in range(model.get_action_dim(unnorm_key)):
            out = model.language_model(inputs_embeds=outputs, past_key_values=past, use_cache=True)
            past = out.past_key_values
            next_id = out.logits[:, -1, :].argmax(dim=-1)
            generated_ids.append(next_id.item())
            outputs = model.get_input_embeddings()(next_id.unsqueeze(0))
    predicted_action = np.array(

    ) + np.array(generated_ids) / (model.config.n_action_bins - 1) * (
